mode: paper-first independent implementation; author programs and output workbooks remain unread
index_mapping_basis: Paper PDF page 11 reports a January 1871-October 2019 mean of 9.71%; War_base has mean 0.09710069; War_main has mean 0.08723316. Mapping was fixed before pricing estimation.
post_first_run_amendment: Retain the original War_base specification and add a separately labelled published_series track using War_main and observed-month lags. The predeclared all-index sensitivity found the closest published numerical correspondence with this series. A later AR-window check excluded the pre-start lag and left small published discrepancies. Numerical correspondence does not establish seed-word provenance. Author code and author output workbooks remain unread.

ar.basis: Paper PDF pages 14-15, equations 3-4 and footnote 13; rolling window length and initial minimum are unspecified. Expanding estimation through the current month is an explicit implementation assumption.

two_pass.first_pass: OLS with intercept over the full selected sample
two_pass.second_pass: OLS of time-series average excess returns on a constant and full-sample estimated betas
two_pass.inference: Shanken covariance with residual and factor covariance divisors T; factor covariance term included
two_pass.inference_sensitivity: conditional covariance omitting factor covariance term, and residual degrees-of-freedom adjustment
two_pass.basis: Paper PDF pages 14-15, equations 1-2; Table I-V notes. This is distinct from rolling-beta Fama-MacBeth.

portfolio_filter: From test_portfolios_original.rds, select the stated sample, then retain assets with all monthly returns observed before applying factor availability. Preserve the supplied return units and record that excess-return provenance is not fully documented by generic column names.
nontraded_scaling: Multiply each comparison factor by sd(WarFac)/sd(factor) on its own matched estimation sample; do not demean.

industry.formation: estimate betas through t-1; predict returns at t
industry.rank: quintiles of crisis-related betas rescaled to [0,1]; FF3 betas unranked
industry.hac: Bartlett, lag 6, no prewhitening, no finite-sample adjustment
industry.basis: Paper PDF pages 37-38, equations 5-6. HAC lag and exact tie convention are unspecified; lag 6 and deterministic average-rank quintiles are explicit assumptions.

wmp: Cross-sectional slopes on full-sample WarFac betas of the 360 tree portfolios; time-series projection excludes its intercept when constructing the mimicking return. Both are retrospective, not feasible trading strategies.
missing_inputs: Firm characteristics, capitalizations and delisting records needed to reconstruct supplied portfolio returns
Article-level topic weights for Appendix G
comparison_policy: Compare estimates with published tables only after the implementation and synthetic checks are written. Do not modify choices solely to reduce published discrepancies. Never read author code in this task.
